Portrait 9:16 photograph using only the room from the attached photo: dark wood walls crowded with framed pictures, low patterned ceiling, warm tungsten wall lamps; every sign plain dark wood, a small speaker on a stand in the far corner. Foreground, out of focus: the backs of two people at the next table, leaning towards the camera's subject. Beyond them, sharp: four men huddled round one small table, whispering over a single answer sheet. A plaster-dusted plasterer in his forties, a banker in his fifties with tie loosened, a student of about twenty in a hoodie, and a weathered man in his fifties in an old waterproof jacket gripping the pen. Pints, crisp packets, short pencils. Every other table full. New faces, mixed ethnicities. 35mm lens, busy and warm. No lettering.
Thanks.
